Readiness — dependencies reachable. 503 when not ready (for load-balancer probes).

delete.summary: Delete a manually-created pair from a draft run

post.summary: Add a duplicate pair to resolve an odd-one-out player
post.description: When a squad has an odd number of players the engine leaves one player unpaired. The captain resolves this by choosing an existing player to partner the odd-one-out, allowing that player to compete in two pairs.  The resulting pair is locked so a regenerate does not remove it.

get.description:
Anonymous SSE subscription to this tournament's own channel — never the org
channel. Re-validates visibility the same way every other public read does; no
principal, no `is_authorized` (that's the authenticated-only gate).

ActivityEventView.title: ActivityEventView
ActivityEventView.description:
One row of the org-wide audit trail (`AuditLog`), scoped to a single tournament —
the source for the Match Center's activity timeline.

AddDuplicatePairRequest.title: AddDuplicatePairRequest
AddDuplicatePairRequest.description:
Captain assigns a partner to an odd-one-out player by choosing an existing
player to play twice.  The resulting duplicate pair is locked automatically so
a regenerate does not remove it.

``unpaired_id``  – registration id of the player who currently has no partner.
``duplicate_id`` – registration id of the player who will play a second match.

take.title: Take
take.description: Number of top-ranked participants to advance

BulkCreateCourtsRequest.title: BulkCreateCourtsRequest
BulkCreateCourtsRequest.description: Create numbered courts at a venue and assign them to the tournament.

CheckInRequest.title: CheckInRequest
CheckInRequest.description: Set attendance for a single participant. ``status`` ∈ pending|checked_in|absent.

CreateManualPairRequest.title: CreateManualPairRequest
CreateManualPairRequest.description:
Create a pair manually within a draft PairingRun.

``member_ids`` must contain 1–2 registration ids. Each id must be an entrant in the
run's division (or squad) and must not already belong to an unpublished team in this
run.

gamesPerTie.title: Gamespertie
gamesPerTie.description: Doubles legs per squad-vs-squad tie; defaults to min pairs per squad

sourceStageId.title: Sourcestageid
sourceStageId.description: Franchise RR stage whose squad standings seed the bracket

advanceCount.title: Advancecount
advanceCount.description: Top N squads from source standings; defaults to all squads

ImportRequest.title: ImportRequest
ImportRequest.description:
Shared shape for preview + commit — the raw upload, the chosen source, and the
column → target-field mapping. Preview is a dry run; commit applies it.

MatchResultEventView.title: MatchResultEventView
MatchResultEventView.description:
One row of the append-only scoring/correction log for a match (`MatchResultEvent`) —
the source of truth for Match Detail's history panel.

ScorekeeperSessionView.title: ScorekeeperSessionView
ScorekeeperSessionView.description: Public scorekeeper page — one match only, resolved from the token.

SportMatchConfigView.title: SportMatchConfigView
SportMatchConfigView.description: Resolved sport rules for this match (tournament defaults + stage overrides).

SwapMembersRequest.title: SwapMembersRequest
SwapMembersRequest.description: Swap two members between their (different) proposed teams — a manual override.

UpdateCourtRequest.title: UpdateCourtRequest
UpdateCourtRequest.description: Partial update — omitted fields are left unchanged.

UpdateStageConfigRequest.title: UpdateStageConfigRequest
UpdateStageConfigRequest.description:
Partial sport-config override for a stage (e.g. ``{"bestOf": 1}``).
Only allowed before the stage is locked (first scored result). Snake_case and
camelCase keys are both accepted; unknown keys are ignored.

UploadTarget.title: UploadTarget
UploadTarget.description: Where and how the client uploads the bytes directly (presigned).
